headline: Government Bond Liquidity Surges Strongly Last Week
summary: Liquidity in Vietnam's government bond market surged last week, with total secondary trading value reaching VND 133,400 billion, up nearly 65%.
why: Government bonds are the benchmark fixed-income market for pricing risk and borrowing costs across an economy. Trading volumes indicate how easily investors can buy and sell sovereign debt.
